Description: New influenza infections occurring at force of infection λ(t) = β I(t) / N.
Progression from exposed to infectious at rate σ.

Name: β
Value: not explicitly estimated in the paper's primary parameter table; implied through λ(t) = β I(t) / N

Name: σ
Description: Rate of becoming infectious; corresponds to an average incubation period of 1/σ = 1 day as stated in the paper.

Name: γ
Description: Rate of recovery; corresponds to an average infectious period of 1/γ ≈ 21 days as stated in the paper.

Name: N2012/13
Description: Population size used for the 2012/13 season.

Name: N2013/14
Description: Population size used for the 2013/14 season.

Name: N2014/15
Description: Population size used for the 2014/15 season.

Name: η
Description: Over-dispersion parameter for the Negative Binomial observational model.

Name: pICU
Description: Probability of ICU admission given infection.

Name: µICU_E
Description: Mean time from infection to ICU admission.

Name: σ2ICU_E
Description: Variance of time from infection to ICU admission.
